description:
A hand-written binding of one app to the generic HTTP or browser runner.

An ``http`` binding needs ``spec_url``. A ``browser`` binding needs ``start_url`` and
may add ``login``. Each transport rejects the other's fields.

spec_url.description: Where to fetch the app's OpenAPI specification; required for `http`. `${NAME}` references are expanded from the environment by the engine.
spec_url.title: Spec Url

start_url.description: The page the browser opens first; required for `browser`. `${NAME}` references are expanded from the environment by the engine.
start_url.title: Start Url

secret_headers.description: Headers the engine adds to matching requests; never shown to the runner agent.
secret_headers.title: Secret Headers

submissions.description: Endpoints whose calls send the user's message. Empty means the engine's default rule: any POST, PUT or PATCH with a JSON body.
submissions.title: Submissions

forbidden_calls.description: Calls the engine refuses to send.
forbidden_calls.title: Forbidden Calls

preflight_reads.description: Paths the engine reads before a trial; a failure is a warning only.
preflight_reads.title: Preflight Reads
